localProbe.interpretation: The public feed clearly carries TCC-relevant fields, but exact semantic parity with the documented external API is not yet proven. Differences may be normalization/schema rather than price-value disagreement; status identifiers require mapping before any runtime use.

safetyDecision.reason: The endpoint is undocumented/unsupported, may change without notice, automated use may be subject to site terms, and a national sweep would require roughly 582 sequential requests at the observed page-size ceiling.
safetyDecision.nextSafeAction: Use only small bounded probes and single-location comparisons to understand tariff normalization and EVSE/status identifier mapping. Keep the documented external API as the authoritative ingestion path until parity and policy suitability are demonstrated.

officialExternalApiStateAtAssessment.reason: At assessment time a full real hour had not yet elapsed since the last successful live batch.
